overview:
**Fire danger is Low today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, kept in check by cool fall weather and only moderate dead-fuel dryness (ERC 51%, BI 50%).**

- Danger stays mostly Low through November 2, ticking up briefly to Moderate tomorrow before easing further by October 30 as ERC/BI percentiles drop into the 36–40% range.
- Sunny skies and light winds dominate through Wednesday, with highs sliding from near 56°F today toward the upper 30s–40s by next week; NWS shows no active alerts or Red Flag Warning for the area.
- Local watchout check: 0 of 7 thresholds met — no elevated fire-behavior concerns today.
- Light precipitation (0.24" and 0.07") is forecast for November 1–2, which should further dampen fuels.
Delta County lifted its Stage 1 restrictions Sept. 18, and Montrose County lifted Stage 1 restrictions Sept. 16; Ouray County rescinded all fire restrictions for unincorporated areas in mid-September, and Gunnison Field Office Stage 1 fire restrictions have been lifted, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remaining in effect — no county or BLM fire restrictions are currently active in this area.
- No wildfires are burning in or near this area; the national sit report's only uncontained large fire is in Wyoming, unrelated to these counties.
